title: Full Spectrum 10X Mushroom Complex Veggie Capsules
body:
Full Spectrum Support - Focus, Energy, Immunity, Gut Health

Our Mushroom Complex Capsules feature a potent blend of the most well-known and research-backed functional mushrooms—Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Cordyceps, Chaga, Shiitake, Maitake, Turkey Tail, Royal Sun, White Button, and Black Fungus.

Formulated to support mental clarity, immune health, and sustained energy, these capsules are designed for people who want to stay sharp, resilient, and balanced—whether you're working, training, or just navigating a busy life.*

With zero sugar, no added flavoring, and a fast-absorbing veggie capsule format, they’re perfect for anyone who prefers a clean, convenient way to get their daily mushroom boost—no gummies, powders, or mixing required.

🌿 Key Benefits

  • Promotes mental clarity, immune health, and natural energy*
  • Includes 10 mushroom extracts in fast-absorbing capsule form
  • No sugar, flavors, or sweeteners—just clean, concentrated mushrooms
  • Vegan, non-GMO, and made in the USA

Ingredients: Cordyceps Sinensis Powder, Reishi Mushroom Extract, Shiitake Mushroom Extract, Lion's Mane, Proprietary Blend (Maitake Mushroom Extract, Turkey Tail Extract, Chaga Mushroom Extract, Royal Sun Agaricus Extract, White Button Mushroom Extract, Black Fungus Extract), Hypromellose (vegetable capsule), Microcrystalline Cellulose, Magnesium Stearate.

Free From: Gluten, Lactose, Allergens, Hormones, Antibiotics, GMOs, Corn
Suitable For: Vegan, Vegetarian diets

Manufactured in: USA
Amount: 60 capsules
Gross Weight: 0.25lb (113g)

Suggested Use: As a dietary supplement, take two (2) vegetable capsules once daily. For best results, take 20–30 minutes before a meal with 8 oz (240 ml) of water or as directed by your healthcare professional.

Caution: Do not exceed the recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement.

Warning: Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if the safety seal is damaged or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
